text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey there. Care to be featured in our 
Trainer special?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We distribute a PR magazine about the 
Twinkle Series to overseas racing 
personnel, and in one of its columns...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I, for one, would definitely like to 
recommend you. After all, your passion for 
Umamusume is truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I would love to hear your thoughts on 
this. That way, we can show the overseas 
racing world the high level of 
Japanese—...oh?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't be humble. You are wonderful. If I 
say so, there is no mistake. ...Please 
consider it.
